olders.part: in part — Decision §1 (the epic is a permanent record in the product model, at {domain}/slices/{slice-id}/epics/{epic-id}.yaml, with `delivered` as its terminal state) and §2 (/launch stamps the epic `delivered` in place); also its Context's premise that a slice is cut into one or more epics
§1 'The surface lives on the epic, as structure' (the `surface` block in epic.yaml) and §2 'Declared at cut' (/grill declares it when it cuts the epic)

§1 'Anchored, always' and §2 'Append-only' — the anchor is a delivered epic record on the slice, and 'a slice's current truth = its epics + their amendments'; §6 the home 'on the slice beside the epics'; and the Context's premise 'delivered epics cannot be reopened'

§3 'Execute' (its first step, /grill, cuts the slice into epics) and '/grill needs only a slice' (the play that cuts epics checks only that the slice exists); also its Context's realized stamp ('/measure stamps the slice realized')
§1 'Two levels' — the sentence 'Every piece of agent work still takes ICE form; the business intent is what that work points at'
the word only — 'functionality' is now 'feature' in its rules, and the holding folder `functionalities/<id>/` is now `features/<id>/` (§1, §3 'functionality → capability → domain')
§4 'Plays take the verb of what they do' — the sentence 'Objects use the product model's words (feature, capability), never a word the model dropped (epic, slice)'

the word only — 'one ICE for each capability and each functionality' holds as 'each capability and each feature'; §5 'A functionality has exactly one parent capability' and its holding folder read 'feature' and `features/`
